subject: Engineering integration warroom + sprint ownership for EdgeWorks MAP
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgeworks.com>; Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@edgeworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-03 09:02 -0700
Subject: Engineering integration warroom + sprint ownership for EdgeWorks MAP

Maya / Carlos —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. Per our conversation I've pulled together an operational approach that will help edgeworks and Redwood move through the first 90 days with clear owners, acceptance gates, and an "integration warroom" cadence for the trickier infra and auth pieces.

Attached: EW-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (milestones + owners) and integration-checklist.csv (initial dependency inventory). High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the staging cutover windows below (we propose 3/22–3/24 for first smoke).
- Share SSO test credentials ahead of our engineering warroom on 3/08.
- Confirm who owns the firewall/proxy change requests on your side (we have Carlos flagged, confirm if this stands).

Proposed sprint lanes and owners (first 30 days):
- Infra & Networking (owner: Carlos A.) — firewall rules, VPC peering, egress policies.
- Auth & Keys (owner: Maya S.) — SSO, SCIM, KMS access for logs.
- Runtime Integration (owner: Jonas W. / Redwood Eng) — model routing config, prefix caching checks.
- QA & Acceptance (owner: Mina H.) — smoke tests, token-level assertions, performance baselines.

Warroom cadence: 3x / week standups (Mon/Wed/Fri) for the first 2 weeks, then move to twice weekly. I'll send a recurring Zoom invite once we confirm the owners.

If that looks good, Priyom will update the MAP spreadsheet with final dates and we'll fold the agreed SOW items into the procurement queue.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EW-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (breakout by day), integration-checklist.csv (CSV list of dependencies)

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgeworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@edgeworks.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-03 11:27 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineering integration warroom + sprint ownership for EdgeWorks MAP

Jonas —

Thanks, this looks reasonable. A few quick confirmations:

- Staging window is OK: we'll reserve 3/22–3/24 and provide a dedicated environment.
- I can own SSO work with our identity team; I'll share a test account by Monday 3/08 EOD.
- Firewall/proxy owner is me (Carlos will handle the actual change requests with infra).

Two asks from EdgeWorks:
1) Can Redwood provide a short checklist for the SSO smoke tests you expect? (username/password flow + SCIM create user + token audit).
2) We need an explicit rollback plan for the 3/24 cutover in case token throughput exceeds baseline.

I'll review the MAP and send annotated comments by 3/05.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Platform Engineering
EdgeWorks Inc.

Attachment: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgeworks.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04 08:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineering integration warroom + sprint ownership for EdgeWorks MAP

Morning team —

I've updated the MAP spreadsheet with the annotated owner commitments and tentative milestone dates (see Drive link in thread). Changes of note:
- Added a QA smoke test checklist under the "Acceptance" tab (covers SSO, SCIM, token audit, 95th percentile latency checks).
- Added a rollback decision gate for the 3/24 cutover: if token error rate > 1.5% for 15m rolling, we execute staged rollback to previous routing for 30 minutes and open P1.
- Moved the initial end-to-end smoke to 3/23 09:00 PT (edgeworks staging + Redwood test harness).

Warroom logistics:
- First warroom: 2027-03-08 10:00–11:00 PT (agenda: SSO creds handoff, firewall timeline, test account verification). Zoom link in Drive doc.
- Recurring standups: Mon/Wed/Fri 09:30 PT (15m) for first two weeks.

Next steps for EdgeWorks: please upload the SSO test user and SCIM demo account to the shared Drive folder and confirm the firewall change ticket ID. For Redwood: I'll coordinate the test harness and ensure a token tracking dashboard is live for the smoke.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_EdgeWorks_Redwood_v3.pdf (procurement placeholder)

From: Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@edgeworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@edgeworks.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05 17:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineering integration warroom + sprint ownership for EdgeWorks MAP

All —

Quick update after internal infra sync: firewall change request created (Ticket FW-1129). Target apply window: 3/08 02:00–04:00 PT (pre-windows maintenance). We'll confirm the scope on 3/08 warroom.

Also: one risk to flag — our compliance team requires that any KMS changes go through a 72-hour approval window. That may push some key rotation tests to 3/11–3/13 unless we get an exception.

I propose we list that as a dependency on the MAP and have Mina help with test prioritization so acceptance doesn't block the entire cutover.

See you in the warroom on 3/08.

—Carlos
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
EdgeWorks Inc.
